This build does not include the diary engine for this device\'s processor.\n\nInstall the arm64-v8a build.
The diary could not open. Check the log for details:\n\nadb logcat -s riddle
The diary reads your handwriting and sends it to a vision model, then writes the reply back by hand. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Without a key the diary still opens, but it cannot answer.
The oracle answered nothing. Check the key, endpoint and model.
No API key: the diary will open but cannot answer.

Every finished page is kept on this device — your strokes, a transcription, and Tom\'s reply — so you can ask to see a past page again. Nothing else is stored, and turning this off sends no history with a request.
Deletes every remembered page from this device. The diary cannot get them back.
Delete every remembered page? This cannot be undone.
